nodes.description: Public provenance hash string state variable set by the owner via setProvenanceHash.
Constant price per Kong (0.01 ether) read during mint verification.
Constant maximum Kongs purchasable per transaction (3).
Constant maximum Kong supply (24) used for supply and index modulo checks.
Mutable reveal deadline used in _setStartingIndexBlock and settable by owner.
Boolean sale switch toggled by the owner in flipSaleState and read in mint verification.
Block number recorded for pseudo-random starting index derivation.
Derived starting index for token ordering, set once in setStartingIndex.
Guard flag preventing repeated owner reservations in reserveKongs.
External payable mint entry point; verifies purchase, loops _safeMint to msg.sender and finalizes the starting index block.
External function deriving startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) modulo MAX_KONGS (weak randomness).
Private validation of sale state, per-tx purchase limit, supply cap and ETH payment.
Private function that records block.number when supply is exhausted or the reveal timestamp has passed.
Private function ensuring the starting index has not been set and its block is known.
Owner-only function updating REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-only function storing the provenance hash.
Owner-only function updating the ERC721 base URI.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Owner-only fallback that forces startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Owner-only function transferring the whole contract balance to the caller.
Owner-only function minting five reserved Kongs to the caller once.
Constructor setting token metadata and REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from the sale start parameter.
Untrusted caller address used as mint recipient, transfer recipient and owner-check subject.
Timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in _setStartingIndexBlock (timestamp dependency).
Native coin transfer to msg.sender in withdraw, an external value transfer point.
_safeMint performing an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient contract.
Modulo arithmetic over blockhash-derived value used as pseudo-random starting index.
Number of tokens requested in mintKong, forwarded to _verifyMintKong and the mint loop.
New reveal timestamp argument of setRevealTimestamp.
Provenance hash string argument of setProvenanceHash.
Base URI string argument of setBaseURI.
Sale start timestamp argument of the constructor used to compute REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Mint index of the current token in the mintKong loop (totalSupply snapshot).
Loop counter of the mintKong mint loop.
blockhash(startingIndexBlock) value used to derive startingIndex.
Contract balance snapshot read in withdraw before transfer.
Loop counter of the reserveKongs reservation loop.

edges.reason: numberOfTokens parameter drives the mintKong loop bound.
numberOfTokens is validated against the purchase limit in _verifyMintKong.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintKong.
mintKong calls _verifyMintKong before minting.
saleIsActive is read to gate minting.
maxKongPurchase bounds the number of tokens per transaction.
MAX_KONGS caps total supply during verification.
kongPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens to check msg.value.
MAX_KONGS bounds the mintIndex check inside the mintKong loop.
mintKong triggers _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received callback before the function completes.
mintIndex is passed as the tokenId to _safeMint.
msg.sender is the recipient of the _safeMint callback.
mintKong invokes _setStartingIndexBlock after the mint loop.
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, creating a timestamp dependency.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP drives the timestamp-dependent reveal condition.
MAX_KONGS is compared with totalSupply in _setStartingIndexBlock.
_setStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock when conditions are met.
setStartingIndex calls _verifySetStartingIndex first.
startingIndexBlock is used as blockhash input to derive startingIndex.
setStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
hashOfBlock local holds the blockhash used for the starting index computation.
setStartingIndex performs modular arithmetic on a blockhash value to derive randomness.
MAX_KONGS is the modulus operand of the starting index computation.
startingIndex must still be zero for the verification to pass.
startingIndexBlock must be non-zero for the verification to pass.
setRevealTimestamp is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
setProvenanceHash is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
setBaseURI is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
flipSaleState is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
withdraw is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
reserveKongs is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
revealTimeStamp argument is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setRevealTimestamp updates the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
provenanceHash argument is stored into RKL_PROVENANCE.
setProvenanceHash writes the RKL_PROVENANCE state variable.
baseURI argument is forwarded to the ERC721 base URI setter.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to be zero.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock forces startingIndexBlock to block.number.
saleStart argument is used in arithmetic to compute REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
constructor initializes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
withdraw sends the full balance to msg.sender, an external value transfer point.
balance local is the transferred amount.
msg.sender is the recipient of the native transfer in withdraw.
reserveKongs calls _safeMint which triggers an external onERC721Received callback.
alreadyReserved is read to prevent repeated reservations.
reserveKongs sets alreadyReserved to true after minting.

normalization_plan.reason: The numberOfTokens parameter exists only to feed the validation routine and mint loop of the core minting logic.
revealTimeStamp only carries the owner-supplied value into the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP update.
provenanceHash only carries the owner-supplied value into the RKL_PROVENANCE update.
baseURI only carries the owner-supplied value into the ERC721 base URI update.
saleStart only feeds the constructor computation of REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintIndex is a transient loop-local value used to call _safeMint.
The loop counter only controls iteration of the mintKong mint loop.
hashOfBlock is a transient local holding the blockhash used to derive startingIndex.
balance is the transient amount passed into the native transfer operation.
The loop counter only controls iteration of the reservation minting loop.
